title: Worth every penny
body:
If you’re looking for a well-designed, capable habit tracker that encourages you to keep up with your habits, this is it! 

I bought the lifetime subscription last year and it was some of the best money I ever spent on an app. 5/5 would recommend.
author: Kevin0c

title: Excellent App!
body: It’s very useful and makes you much more accountable when trying to build new habits.
author: Jess751#

title: Too expensive
body: Nice app but you can only add two habits unless you pay. It’s just a bit too expensive for what it does.
author: Rebecca1037

title: Don’t work on Apple Watch series 3
body: The application doesn’t work on Apple Watch OS 7.
